title: Wrap line
why: A line exceeds the recommended style length.
suggestion: Wrap the expression using the language formatter.
limitations: Dart is excluded because dart format may intentionally exceed its page width.
Whitespace-only lines, including padding left by excluded inline test regions, are not wrappable code.
Prettier and Biome widths apply only to supported web syntax. Other languages require an explicit matching EditorConfig width; custom formatter-plugin languages are not inferred.
